France–Hong Kong Double Taxation Agreement (2010, in force from 2011)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Articles L.561-1 through L.561-59 and R.561-1 et seq. of the French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier); Articles L.123-23-1 and R.123-220-4 through R.123-220-10 of the French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) establishing the registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE); transposition of EU Directive (EU) 2015/849.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or notary in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus certified French translation by a sworn translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and statutes of any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry of the corporate shareholder's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille, or consular legalization for non-Hague Convention jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Tax residence certificate of the UBO or corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Sovereign tax authority of the shareholder's country
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille plus certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds of the investors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank or financial institution of the investor
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: SWIFT authenticated bank letter and notarial certification of signature

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Sworn French translation of all foreign-language corporate and identity documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Certified translator registered with a French court of appeal (cour d'appel)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Authentication before a French notary or consular legalization chain

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence on politically exposed persons under Article L.561-10 of the French Monetary and Financial Code. Systematic screening against the French national asset-freeze list (FIC), the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UN Security Council sanctions lists, and OFAC sanctions for any USD clearing transactions. Additional sanctions screening of all UBOs and corporate officers for EU restrictive measures and French counter-terrorist financing measures under Article R.562-6.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises operated by INPI at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr; name search additionally through Infogreffe and INPI data-sol databases
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name may be selected in a foreign language but must be expressed in a transliterated Latin-script form for registration purposes. All mandatory company records, including commercial invoices, contracts and governance documents, must be maintained in French as required by Article L.121-1 of the French Consumer Code. The name must not be misleading as to the legal form, business activity, or authorized capital.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: names of French departments or municipalities without authorization
expressions contrary to public order or morality
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the Greffe du tribunal de commerce rejects the proposed corporate name during incorporation, the applicant may submit an administrative rectification request to the same registrar within 15 days. If the rejection is confirmed, the applicant may file summary proceedings (référé) before the President of the competent Commercial Court under Article R.123-227 of the French Commercial Code. For refusals issued by INPI through the Guichet unique, the applicant may bring an appeal before the competent administrative court within two months of notification.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only for administrative registered-office purposes. A licensed French domiciliation company may host the registered office, provided the domiciliation contract is filed with the commercial registry and the company retains effective administrative management in France. This does not replace the mandatory physical manufacturing establishment required for the production of dialysis hemofilters, which must be separately approved as a medical-device manufacturing site.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 55% annual likelihood of unannounced physical inspection during the first two operating years, given that the manufacture of dialysis consumables falls under mandatory oversight by ANSM (Agence nationale de sécurité du médicament et des produits de santé) under Articles L.5311-1 and R.5211-1 et seq. of the French Public Health Code.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Law firm drafting and notarization of articles of association (statuts de SARL)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Private law firm or French notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market legal fee; notarial emoluments regulated by decree in part

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of incorporation notice in an approved legal announcements gazette (annonce légale)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official tariff set by ministerial arrêté per word or line

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: RCS/Greffe registration filing fee (dépôt au greffe du tribunal de commerce)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official court registry administrative fee applicable to new SARL registrations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du tribunal de commerce or professional fiduciary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed registry fee plus prevailing fiduciary service charge

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Bank account opening and initial AML/UBO clearance fee
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French licensed bank or payment institution

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market tariff for commercial domiciliation, subject to applicable statutory caps

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French consulate or embassy of the origin state, apostille office, and sworn translator
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official consular and apostille fee schedules; sworn translator's fixed per-page rate

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce) – Book II, Title III, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 et seq. (SARL); general provisions on the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés, Articles L.123-1 to L.123-54; implementing decree n° 2021-300 of 18 March 2021 establishing the Guichet Unique.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce of the registered office jurisdiction (RCS – Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés), receiving electronic filings via the Guichet Unique operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) at formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts constitutifs (Articles of Association) submitted through the single declaration form M0 – 'Déclaration de création d'une personne morale', per decree n° 2021-300.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital; SARL may be formed with €1. Cash contributions must be paid up to at least 20% upon subscription, balance within 5 years; in-kind contributions must be fully liberated at formation and, where value exceeds €30,000, a statutory valuations auditor (commissaire aux apports) must be appointed unless unanimously waived. No mandatory escrow account for cash contributions; funds are held on a provisional bank account until registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTIONS OF THE CONSTITUENT SHAREHOLDERS' MEETING OF [COMPANY NAME] SARL held at the registered office on [date]. The undersigned shareholders, acting unanimously, resolve: (1) the company is constituted with effect upon registration with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés; (2) the subscription of the share capital of EUR [amount], allocated as set out in the Articles of Association, and the deposit of corresponding funds are approved; (3) the registered office established at [address] is adopted; (4) [full name] is appointed Gérant for the corporate duration, vested with the broadest powers to operate the company and open bank accounts; (5) all registration filings and legal publications are authorised. Each resolution is adopted unanimously. Certified copy of minutes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and execution of the French Articles of Association (Statuts) with appointment of the Gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private deed signed by all shareholders (notarisation optional unless real property is contributed); subsequent control by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via the Guichet Unique.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Statuts in French containing all mandatory clauses: corporate form (SARL), corporate name, registered office address, corporate purpose (design, manufacture and sale of disposable dialysis hemofilters under ISIC 3250), duration (maximum 99 years), share capital amount and division into parts sociales, rights attached to shares, identity and powers of the Gérant, decision-making rules, and dissolution provisions. All shareholders must sign personally or through a duly authorised proxy; annex the list of acts performed on behalf of the company in formation (état des actes accomplis).
required_dossiers: Final draft of the Statuts in French
Valid passports/identity documents of all shareholders
Extract of criminal record or declaration of no disqualification (casier judiciaire) of the Gérant
Declaration of beneficial owners (bénéficiaires effectifs) data
Notarised or witnessed proxy if a shareholder is represented
Proof of registered office availability (lease, promissory agreement or title deed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues a query (demande de pièces complémentaires) or a refusal, correct the defective clause or supply the missing exhibits within the 15-day statutory cure period and resubmit electronically at no additional cost; persistent errors may require an amending shareholders' resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the provisional bank account and liberation of the share capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank of the company's choice; fallback to the Banque de France 'droit au compte' procedure if the bank refuses.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the name of the société en formation and deposit the cash subscriptions. Obtain from the bank the attestation de dépôt des fonds and the état des souscriptions et versements listing each shareholder, the number of shares and amounts paid. If in-kind contributions exceed €30,000, appoint a commissaire aux apports to value the assets and attach the valuation report to the Statuts.
required_dossiers: Draft or final Statuts
Identity documents and KYC information for each shareholder and the Gérant
Bank account application form
Source of funds evidence for AML compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses the account (e.g., KYC doubts about the medical device corporate purpose), invoke the Banque de France 'droit au compte' procedure under Article L.312-1 of the Monetary and Financial Code: the Banque de France designates a credit institution compelled to open the account.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the incorporation announcement in an authorised legal notices journal (Journal d'Annonces Légales)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: An approved JAL publisher duly authorised in the département of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the formal notice containing the corporate name, form (SARL), share capital amount, registered office address, corporate purpose, duration, identity of the Gérant and the intended RCS registration court. Deliver the text to the authorised publisher, obtain the attestation de parution proving publication, and retain it for the RCS filing.
required_dossiers: Proposed text of the incorporation notice
Extract of the final Statuts
Written instruction from the Gérant or shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL publisher rejects the notice for discrepancies with the Statuts, amend the wording to match the final articles and republish immediately; a duplicate attestation de parution can be requested at no additional charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic registration filing with the Greffe du RCS via the Guichet Unique (Form M0)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique platform of the INPI (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), transmitting the file to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce having jurisdiction over the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to the Guichet Unique using a verified identity (FranceConnect or assistant registration). Complete the single M0 declaration for création d'une personne morale in French, upload all supporting documents in PDF, electronically sign the declaration and any power of attorney, and settle the prescribed registry fee (approximately €37.52). The registry examines the file and issues the extrait K-bis upon approval.
required_dossiers: Completed M0 form data (corporate names, object, capital, address, officers)
Final Statuts in certified digital copy
Attestation de parution from the JAL
Attestation de dépôt des fonds and état des souscriptions et versements
Proof of registered office (lease or utility invoice)
Identity documents of shareholders and Gérant
Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs completed within the form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe issues a refusal or a request for supplementary documents, remedy the file within the 15-day legal cure period directly in the Guichet Unique; if the period lapses, submit a new M0 with an additional fee. Unlawful refusals are actionable before the Tribunal de Commerce.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-registration tax, social and sectoral activation (SIREN/SIRET, intra-EU VAT ID, URSSAF, ANSM)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INSEE (identification); Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP – corporate tax and VAT); URSSAF (social security affiliation); ANSM (medical device manufacturer registration).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the extrait K-bis, verify that INSEE has automatically activated the SIREN/SIRET numbers and that the DGFiP file is open. Apply for attribution of the intra-community VAT number (TVA intracommunautaire) where needed, complete the tax questionnaire for Impôt sur les Sociétés and CFE, and register as an employer with URSSAF. Simultaneously, register the company as a medical device manufacturer in the ANSM database (SNDI/MDR module) for the planned CE-marking activities of the dialysis hemofilter.
required_dossiers: Extrait K-bis (registration certificate)
Identity document and address of the Gérant
Bank account details (RIB/IBAN)
Completed DGFiP tax questionnaire (form n° 5345-D) where required
MDR technical documentation summary or CE-marking strategy for the device
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the VAT certificate is delayed beyond the statutory deadline, contact the service des impôts des entreprises (SIE) with the K-bis and request immediate issuance; in case of URSSAF classification disputes, file an appeal with the URSSAF or the social security tribunal (TASS/TI) within two months.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Agence Nationale de Sécurité du Médicament et des Produits de Santé (ANSM) – Medical Devices Directorate (Dispositifs Médicaux) for manufacturer registration and CE-marking oversight; Direction Régionale de l'Économie, de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DREETS) and DREAL for industrial establishment and employee safety approvals.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Manufacturer Registration Certificate for medical devices under EU Regulation 2017/745 (MDR) assessed by a Notified Body (organisme notifié) for Class IIa/IIb hollow-fiber dialyzers; plus 'Enregistrement Établissement' as an ICPE Classified Installation under Book V of the French Environmental Code.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL – Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (regional State environmental authority; Inspection des Installations Classées 'ICPE') under the Ministry for the Ecological Transition.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 'Enregistrement' (Registration) under ICPE – e.g., Rubric 2661 (polymer processing with solvent consumption ≥ 10 t/year) or equivalent; requires a simplified environmental assessment file and case-by-case EIA screening (examen au cas par cas) per Article L.512-7 and Article R.122-2 of the Environmental Code.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Discharges to municipal sewer must comply with the decree of 2 February 1998: pH 5.5–9.5, TSS ≤ 600 mg/L, BOD5 ≤ 800 mg/L, COD ≤ 2000 mg/L. VOC emissions are subject to Directive 2010/75/EU (IED) and the decree of 4 May 2009: exhaust air VOC limit ≤ 20 mg C/Nm³, solvent management plan above 150 t/year, and leak detection across extrusion/potting equipment. Hazardous waste (polyethersulfone scrap, epoxy potting residues, rejected filters) must be traced via the Trackdéchets platform and sent to registered recovery or treatment facilities.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification issued by the Commission de Sécurité (CCF) or an accredited technical inspection bureau for production premises; structural load certificate validating floors and mezzanines for ISO 14644 cleanroom equipment; electrical conformity certificate per NF C 15-100 for cleanrooms and process lines; workplace risk assessment (DUERP) and ventilation/ATEX clearance for epoxy resins and any ethylene oxide sterilisation; occupational hygiene clearance from the DREETS labour inspectorate before commissioning.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French SARL obtains SIREN/SIRET from INSEE upon incorporation; foreign-owned entities register with DGFiP for tax identification number (TIN) and file annual declarations; non-resident branches follow similar local registration plus withholding obligations
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box equivalent; hybrid mismatch rules under EU ATAD directive; optional micro-entreprise regime for qualifying small-turnover entities

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: €35,000 annual turnover threshold triggering mandatory registration
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (facturation électronique) for B2B transactions via API integration with French tax authority platform; digital stamping and clearance required for all taxable supplies above threshold

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to goods exported outside the EU and qualifying intra-EU supplies; services provided to non-EU customers qualify when properly substantiated
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Penalties up to 80% of evaded VAT plus interest and criminal sanctions for fraudulent claims; retrospective clawback of zero-rating with full VAT liability reassessment if export proof is insufficient

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France; Direction Générale du Trésor (Treasury Directorate) as the French Foreign Exchange Administration
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Euro is fully convertible for both current and capital account transactions. France applies EU capital movement liberalization; no prior exchange-control authorization is required for passive foreign investment or dividend remittance. However, a French SARL must observe EU and French anti-money laundering law, the 30% withholding tax on dividend distributions to non-resident individuals, and any applicable tax treaty reduction. Bilateral or cross-border payments above EUR 10,000 are captured by the French bank's balance-of-payments report to Banque de France; the company is not required to obtain central bank approval. In exceptional sectors, France's inward FDI screening regulation may impose prior authorization for foreign investment in a company manufacturing items critical for public health.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. France does not impose a forced sale or conversion timeline for export proceeds. Exporters may keep receivables in euro or foreign currency, can re-invoice intra-group, and have no mandatory surrender ratio. Export proceeds must be recorded in the accounting books in accordance with French GAAP, and the customs export declaration must match the revenue amount. For export settlement via a French bank, the bank provides the SARL with an SWIFT statement that serves as balance-of-payments and customs evidence. Foreign-currency receivables are subject to year-end revaluation for statutory financial statements and income tax purposes.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Compte de Blocage) and Operational Account (Compte Courant)
Operational Account (Compte Courant) and Capital Escrow Account
Operational Account with Trade Finance and Documentary Credit facilities
Operational Account and Commercial Letter of Credit issuing account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Operational feasibility: Medium; capital escrow feasibility: Low. Under PSD2, an electronic money institution (EMI) is a payment institution, not a full credit institution, and is generally not empowered to issue the statutory attestation de blocage required to register the SARL's share capital deposit. EMI accounts such as Qonto, Shine, or Revolut Business may be used for day-to-day TT wires, FX conversion, and SEPA transfers, but as secondary liquidity rails they lack the documentary credit, escrow certification, and métier of a full French bank. For capital injection and large cross-border MT103 flows involving medical-device exports, an EMI cannot replace a tier-1 commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law does not require a physical in-person meeting for corporate account opening; regulated remote KYC using an eIDAS-certified video identification process is permitted. In practice, tier-1 French banks will require a live video interview with the gérant (manager) and, if the controlling shareholder is foreign or non-EU resident, a notarized and apostilled corporate resolution and passport pages. Some banks condition opening on a local external accountant or lawyer acting as a branch contact. Unless the manager is blacklisted or a UBO resides in a sanctions-affected jurisdiction, remote opening with videoconference and certified translations is viable for a French SARL.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multi-layered beneficial ownership or opaque trustee/foundation shareholders
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Schematic group ownership diagram identifying all ultimate individuals; audited consolidated financial statements; constitutional documents of each holding layer; certified public register excerpt or certificate of incorporation; legal counsel opinion confirming the corporate ownership chain and absence of bearer-share or quarantine elements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection sourced from a FATF Grey List jurisdiction or a non-cooperative tax jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Formal source-of-funds statement from the remitting bank; notarized share subscription agreement; transaction trail evidencing funds from the remitter's business revenues or existing bank balance; tax residence certificate of the investor; audited balance sheet and profit-and-loss figures supporting the underlying accumulation of wealth.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-payment mismatches, including invoice amounts exceeding customs values or letter-of-credit discrepancies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified commercial invoices and purchase orders; customs export/import declaration data (DEB/DES); Incoterms 2020 clause in the contract; transport documents (CMR, AWB, bill of lading) and insurance certificate; ISO 13485 certificate and EU CE marking of the medical device; internal payment-to-invoice reconciliation schedule.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: PEP or politically exposed person presenting as manager or beneficial owner
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent sanctions/PEP screening report; public professional profile and contact details; sworn declaration of net worth and funding origin; certified police or judicial clearance from the person's country of residence; compliance diligence memorandum prepared by the SARL's external legal counsel, concluding that the PEP is a disclosed and law-abiding actor.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholders initiate a SWIFT MT103 wire from their home-country bank to the SARL's dedicated capital-blocked account (Compte de Blocage) opened in France. The wire beneficiary must be exactly the SARL's name followed by the mandate reference, and the SWIFT narrative must state the purpose code for equity subscription, within the Banque de France balance-of-payments classification for share capital in a resident non-financial company. If the foreign shareholder is non-EU, the transaction is screened under EU and French inward FDI rules; if the dialysis manufacturing activity is considered critical health infrastructure, ministerial authorization may be required before subscription. The bank issues the attestation de blocage to the corporate registrar; upon issuance of the Kbis extract, the funds are released to the SARL's operating account. No separate foreign-exchange approval is required for euro-denominated injections.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: The SARL's principal outbound treasury requirement is import of polyethersulfone resin, hollow fiber membranes, potting adhesives, and sterilization services. These disbursements will be carried out through four rails: (1) SWIFT MT103 wire for open-account and pre-payment terms; (2) an irrevocable documentary letter of credit (SWIFT MT700) issued by the SARL's French bank for high-value raw-material imports, with the supplier presenting transport, insurance, and quality certificates; (3) SEPA credit transfer for same-day euro payments within the EEA; and (4) documentary collection for medium-risk suppliers. The bank will require the commercial invoice, transport document, customs declaration, and underlying purchase order; under French customs law, the SARL must retain export/import records for at least ten years. Settlement is executed only after sanctions/AML adverse-media checks on both counterparties.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright EUR/USD forward contract under the FBF master agreement for hedging trade receivables and raw-material payables.
Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) for illiquid or restricted-convertibility emerging-market currencies only when an underlying physical exposure is proven to a French bank treasury desk.
Cross-currency swap (EUR/USD or EUR/GBP) to hedge medium-term foreign-currency capital expenditure or intra-group loans.
FX swap (spot versus forward combination) for temporary liquidity rebalancing on foreign-currency accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual members' general meeting (assemblée générale ordinaire) approving annual financial statements and any dividend allocation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Internal corporate act; minutes are recorded in the statutory decision book and retained in company records; no direct filing with the registry unless the resolution also requires publication
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 6 months after each financial year close; for a December 31 financial year end, the meeting must be held no later than June 30, unless extended by court order
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late convening exposes the SARL manager (gérant) to liability and court-ordered convocation or appointment of a temporary judicial agent (mandataire de justice) at the company's expense

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements package, comprising balance sheet, profit-and-loss statement, notes, and management report, filed with the Trade and Companies Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), lodged electronically through the INPI Guichet Unique
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after approval by the members and no later than 7 months after the financial year close; for a December 31 year end, filing is due by July 31 absent court-ordered extension
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers a formal notice from the registry, then a judicial injunction (injonction de dépôt) with compulsory payment (astreinte) potentially up to EUR 1,500 per month; persistent non-compliance may lead to legal liability, publication of the default, and in serious cases administrative strike-off from the RCS

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner confirmation and, if relevant, updated declaration of shareholding structure or persons exercising control
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: RCS via the INPI Guichet Unique; recorded in the Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs attached to the company's file
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days after each anniversary of the company's RCS registration; any change in beneficial ownership arising during the year must be declared within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file exposes the legal entity to a fine of up to EUR 10,000 and the manager to a fine of up to EUR 2,000; repeated omission can jeopardize issuance of the Kbis extract and delay banking, tendering, and regulated supply transactions

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory for the SARL if at least two of the following three thresholds are exceeded at the balance-sheet date: balance-sheet total greater than EUR 4,000,000, net turnover greater than EUR 8,000,000, and average workforce greater than 50 employees. Audit is also mandatory for subsidiaries under the control of a parent undertaking and may be requested by members representing at least 10% of share capital.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP under the Plan Comptable Général (Règlement ANC n°2014-03 as amended) and Articles L.123-12 et seq. of the Code de commerce; IFRS is required only for consolidated accounts of certain public-interest or listed groups, not for the standalone statutory accounts of the SARL.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The SARL must maintain at the RCS a complete declaration of its beneficial owners, defined as any natural person holding directly or indirectly more than 25% of capital or voting rights or otherwise exercising control. Every year, within 15 days of the RCS registration anniversary, the company must confirm that the registered beneficial-owner information is accurate; any transfer or change in ownership structure must be separately reported within 30 days. Where no natural-person beneficial owner is identifiable, the statutory managers become the presumed beneficial owners and must be declared.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (registre des associés), updated for each capital transfer or other movement in shares
Register of Directors and Managers (registre des dirigeants), showing identity, powers, and changes in office
Minute Book or Decision Book (registre de décisions), recording annual general meetings, written consultations, and resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 160 - 650 per year (EUR 150 - 600) for professional registered-office domiciliation or company secretarial agent services, depending on municipality and service scope
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,300 - 10,800 per year (EUR 3,000 - 10,000) for a full statutory audit when thresholds are triggered; not incurred by a below-threshold small SARL unless an auditor is voluntarily appointed

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced corporate income tax rate of 15% on the first EUR 42,500 of taxable profit per fiscal year for small and medium enterprises with turnover below EUR 10 million; statutory social solidarity contribution of 3.3% on corporate income tax payable exceeding EUR 763,000 for large taxpayers; Research Tax Credit (CIR) at 30% of qualifying research expenditure capped at EUR 100 million; innovation tax credit at 20%; patent box regime offering 10% effective tax rate on qualifying intellectual property income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065-SD (statement of results) together with supporting schedules 2058-SD and the standard tax balance-sheet annexes 2050-SD to 2059-SD; mandatory electronic filing through the State e-filing portal impots.gouv.fr using the professional mode (Mode Professionnel / EFI or EDI).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual corporate income tax return; quarterly instalment payments of corporate income tax are due on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December, with the final balance payable upon filing the annual return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a fiscal year ending 31 December, the annual return must be filed no later than 2 May of the following calendar year (the second business day after 1 May); for a fiscal year ending on any other date, the deadline is within three months after the fiscal year-end (e.g., 31 March closing: 30 June; 30 September closing: 31 December).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of the company, SIREN/SIRET numbers, APE/NAF code (3250 for medical and dental instruments and supplies), legal form (SARL), registered office address, fiscal year start and end dates, and principal activity of the dialysis filter manufacturing plant.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a French permanent establishment of a foreign company, enter the French PE's SIRDH/SIRET identification, local address, the non-resident head office name and country of tax residence, and identify the type of establishment using the dedicated PE code.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Case 2 - Box C (Taxable profit or loss)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting net income or loss adjusted for non-deductible expenses, fiscal depreciation, provision reversals, tax-exempt subsidies and final taxable result.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include only profits attributable to the French PE in accordance with the OECD authorised approach; head-office expenses are deductible only if directly attributable and substantiated; losses of the foreign head office cannot offset French PE profits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Case 3 - Box B (Tax losses carried forward)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of prior-year fiscal losses deducted from current taxable income, including the balance of the loss carryforward position and, where applicable, loss carryback claims.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident company's French PE may use only losses incurred by that PE in France; losses of the foreign head office and losses of other foreign branch operations are not available for offset against French PE income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Case 4 - Box D (Tax credits and reductions)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reduced-rate SME income, research tax credit, innovation tax credit, withholding tax certificates, and other imputation credits affecting corporate income tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident companies may claim treaty tax credits and domestic credits only to the extent allowed under the relevant double tax treaty; a valid tax residence certificate and supporting documentation must be attached.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Case 5 - Box E (Corporate income tax payable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculation of gross corporate income tax, social solidarity surcharge where applicable, deduction of already-paid quarterly instalments, and computation of the balance of tax due or credit.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the instalments actually paid by the French PE, attach the payment confirmations, and settle any remaining balance with the public accountant; overpayments may be refunded after the assessment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of 5% of the unpaid tax amount plus late interest at 0.20% per month; after a formal notice is ignored, an additional penalty of 10% applies, rising to 40% for deliberate delay and 80% for fraudulent conduct; the fiscal authorities can further assess a 1.5% monthly increase for unpaid tax and initiate criminal prosecution under Article 1741 of the French General Tax Code.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% on gross dividends paid to a non-resident corporate shareholder under Article 119 bis of the French General Tax Code; the rate is increased to 75% for distributions to a non-cooperative State; bilateral double tax treaties generally reduce the rate to 0%, 5% or 15%; the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive eliminates withholding tax for qualifying direct 10% corporate participants holding shares for at least two years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident shareholder must file Form 5000 (tax residence certificate) and, when seeking reduced or zero DTA rate, Form 5002 or Form 5003 with the paying French company before the payment date, accompanied by an official tax residence certificate issued by the shareholder's domestic tax authority; the French paying agent must retain these documents for audit. Payments made without treaty documentation may be recovered through a refund claim filed with the local tax administration within two years after the payment, using Form 5000 and supporting evidence of beneficial ownership.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: domestic statutory withholding tax of 25% under Article 182 B of the French General Tax Code on payments for patents, know-how, trademarks and other intellectual property; treaty rates commonly reduce this to 0% or 5%; the EU Interest and Royalties Directive provides 0% withholding for royalties paid between associated enterprises of EU Member States. Interest: generally no domestic withholding tax applies to ordinary arm's length interest paid to non-resident lenders; however, a 75% withholding tax applies to payments to entities domiciled in a non-cooperative State; most double tax treaties allocate taxing rights to the residence state, resulting in 0% French withholding.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: EUR 400 million in annual turnover or total balance sheet at the entity level triggers mandatory transfer pricing documentation (Local File and supporting Master File); group consolidated turnover exceeding EUR 750 million triggers the additional Country-by-Country Report obligation. For a typical French SARL manufacturing dialysis consumables, the mandatory threshold is usually not met, but the underlying related-party transactions must still be disclosed on the annual Form 2257-SD and must be supported by contemporaneous arm's-length evidence if selected for a tax audit.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France does not operate a separate Economic Substance Regulations regime, but the general anti-abuse rule under Article L64 of the French Tax Procedures Book and the substance-over-form principle require that a French SARL possess genuine commercial substance: registered office with physical premises, locally appointed management, actual operational staff, production assets, assumption of industrial risk, and complete accounting records maintained in France. An entity without substance, particularly a SARL engaged in dialysis filter production routed through a low-tax centre, may be disregarded by the tax administration, its profits recharacterised to the real economic owner, and treaty benefits denied under the principal purpose test of the OECD Multilateral Instrument.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Wilful omission of French-source profits, falsification of accounting records, deliberate failure to file Form 2065-SD, concealment of production revenues from dialysis consumables sales, or use of fictitious deductible expenses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalty of 40% of the underpaid tax for intentional misdeclaration, increased to 80% for fraudulent manoeuvres, plus late interest at 0.20% per month; criminal sanctions under Article 1741 of the French General Tax Code: fine of EUR 500,000, imprisonment of up to five years, asset confiscation, and prohibition of business activity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or cause fraudulent returns are jointly and severally liable for the corporate tax debt, penalties and interest; the corporate veil may be pierced on a finding of fraud or gross negligence, with directors exposed to civil restitution, personal travel bans and imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a French SARL without genuine economic substance, real management, staff, production assets or commercial risk, merely to claim the reduced SME rate, exploit a treaty, or shift profits away from the actual dialysis filter manufacturing activities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reversal of the artificial transactions and recharacterisation of profit as taxable in France; imposition of an 80% penalty for unjustified tax motive under Article 1728 of the French General Tax Code and the general anti-abuse rule; additional interest and refusal of treaty benefits under the principal purpose test.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who incorporated or operated the sham SARL can be declared personally liable for the entire amount of unpaid taxes and penalties under abus de droit doctrine; the court may disregard the limited liability shield, award civil damages to creditors, and impose travel bans and management disqualification.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Charging non-arm's-length prices for cross-border purchases of polyethersulfone membranes, intercompany royalty payments, or distribution margins attributable to the French SARL; failing to prepare contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation or to file Form 2257-SD.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Tax adjustment of the French taxable base to the arm's-length result; penalty for failure to provide transfer pricing documentation of up to 5% of the value of the undocumented transactions, with a minimum of EUR 50,000 (or EUR 100,000 for entities above the EUR 400 million threshold); additional 40% or 80% penalties for deliberate mispricing, plus late interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable for the assessed tax and penalties where the transfer pricing documentation deficiency is attributable to their intentional conduct; in serious cases, personal criminal liability may arise under the tax fraud provisions, and travel bans can be imposed for unpaid assessments exceeding EUR 50,000.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Use of undisclosed foreign bank accounts, mixing corporate and personal funds, handling large cash payments from dialysis products without adequate traceability, or failing to retain complete accounting, invoices and customs documents for the French production site.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of EUR 1,500 per undeclared foreign bank account (EUR 10,000 if held in a non-cooperative State) under Article 1736 of the French General Tax Code; aggravated penalties for concealment of corporate assets up to EUR 375,000 and five years imprisonment; in addition, the statutory auditor and tax authorities may demand restoration of accounting records and impose non-deductibility of undocumented expenses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for failure to exercise due diligence in accounting and AML controls; the corporate veil may be pierced for want of proper bookkeeping, leading to civil liability for the company's debts, criminal fines, prohibition on managing commercial entities and travel bans.
